summary: Globus Maritime filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing delivery of the M/V Glbs Thalia, a 2026-built ~64,000 DWT Ultramax dry bulk carrier from Nihon Shipyard in Japan, an acquisition previously announced August 23, 2023. No price, premium, or financing terms were disclosed. Fleet now comprises eleven dry bulk carriers totaling ~808,622 DWT, with ten owned/operated vessels per the release. This is a routine fleet-renewal operational update incorporated by reference into existing F-3 shelf registrations, not a special situation; no board recommendation, advisor, or deal mechanics apply.
